{panel:bgColor=#e3fcef}
*OVERALL QA STATUS: PASSED*
{panel}

Tested today on the QA branch [https://sv8745.qa.shopview.com] (build {{v26.39.1-068d31b}}), with production {{app.shopview.com}} (build {{v26.39.2-1aeb22d}}) used to capture the before-state. All 6 checks passed.

In plain terms: on the build our customers are running today, if you open a work-order note and start typing your own name, nothing comes back — you are the one person the list leaves out, which is why the customer could not leave himself a reminder. On this branch your own name is offered like anyone else's, and tagging yourself sends the reminder to you exactly the way tagging a colleague sends it to them.

h3. Before and after

!01-self-tag-before-after.png|width=900,height=1270!

_The same New Note box on a work order. On production I typed my own name, "@Bilal", and the list offered nothing. On the fix branch I typed my own name, "@Admin", and my own account came up ready to pick. The sharpest way to see it on production: typing just "@B" returns "Ahtesham ABCPROD" — matched on the B in the middle of that name — and still does not return "Bilal Muzammil", whose name begins with B._

h3. The reminders it produces

!02-notifications.png|width=900,height=407!

_Three notes where I tagged myself — one on the work order, one on a line, and one added while editing an existing note — all arrived in my own notification list. The top one carries its reminder date of Sep 21 2026, which is the personal reminder the customer was asking for._

h3. Tagging other people

!03-other-users.png|width=900,height=674!

_Nothing was traded away to make this work: tagging a colleague behaves exactly as before, on both builds._

h3. What I checked

||#||Check||Result||
|1|The reported problem still happens on production|*PASSED* — my own name returns nothing; other people's names return them|
|2|A user can tag themselves and the screen accepts it, with no error|*PASSED* — my own account is offered, picking it puts it in the note, and the note saves|
|3|A self-tag goes through the existing notification workflow|*PASSED* — "New mention from Admin ShopView" appeared the moment the note saved|
|4|The reminder is actually visible, with nothing failing quietly|*PASSED* — every self-tag is sitting unread in the notification list, with its reminder date|
|5|It works everywhere notes are written and edited|*PASSED* — work-order note, line note, and editing a note that already existed|
|6|No regression: tagging other people still works|*PASSED* — tagging a colleague still saves against that colleague|

h3. Notes

* The wording under the note box has changed to match the new behaviour: production reads "You can @tag and notify *another* team member", the branch reads "You can @tag a team member". Apart from that and the self-tagging itself, I compared the whole New Note window on both builds and everything else is the same.
* The name suggestions show a shortlist rather than everyone in the company, and stop at ten names. Production does exactly the same, so that is long-standing behaviour and not something this change introduced. Flagging it only so nobody mistakes it for a side effect.
* Nothing was created or changed on production. I opened the note window, typed into it and closed it again.

h3. What I could not check

* The *email* that goes out with a mention. There is no mailbox or mail record I can reach from the application on these accounts, so I verified the in-app notification and the reminder date instead. Stefan's note says the pull request adds explicit self-mention email tests.
* The automated regression test mentioned in the ticket (Playwright case C146191) sits in the pull request rather than in the application, so it is not something I can run from here.
